ITALY: I propose we support each other's opening. I will support A VEN -> TRI. You move A VEN -> TYR or hold. I will hold A VIE or support to BOH. Let's avoid conflict and focus on Germany/France.
RUSSIA: I propose we stay out of each other's way. I will hold A BUD or support to GAL. You move A WAR -> GAL or hold. Let's keep the border quiet and focus on our own fronts.
Please reply with your orders.

FRANCE, ENGLAND. PROPOSAL: COORDINATE TO ELIMINATE GERMANY AND SECURE A 2-WAY DRAW. MY ORDERS: F LON S F BRE - ENG, F EDI - NTH, A LVP - WAL. YOURS: F BRE - ENG, A PAR - BEL, A MAR - GAS. THIS SECURES OUR HOMES AND CONTROLS THE CHANNEL. LET ME KNOW IF YOU AGREE. ENGLAND.

GERMANY, ENGLAND. I AM FOCUSING ON THE NORTH SEA AND ISLES. F LON - ENG, F EDI - NTH, A LVP - WAL. NO INTENT TO TOUCH YOUR COASTS. LET'S MAINTAIN NEUTRALITY IN THE NORTH. IF FRANCE ATTACKS, I WILL SUPPORT HER. BEST, ENGLAND.
FRANCE proposes a peaceful start. I will hold PAR, BRE, MAR. I expect Germany, Italy, and England to respect their borders too. Let's avoid early conflict.
GERMANY: I propose we respect each other's borders. I will not attack BEL or KIE, you do not attack PAR or MUN. Let's keep the peace.
ITALY: I propose we respect each other's borders. I will not attack GAS or MAR, you do not attack PIE or VEN. Let's keep the peace.
ENGLAND: I propose we respect the channel. I will hold BRE, you hold LON/EDI. Let's avoid conflict.
GERMANY: A BER-KIE, A MUN-BOH, F KIE-HEL. I will not attack France. Please hold PAR or move to BEL. Let's keep the peace.
GERMANY: A BER-KIE, A MUN-BOH, F KIE-HEL. I will not attack you. Please hold VIE/TYR or move to BOH. Let's keep the peace.

France, I propose a strong alliance. I will hold my units in Italy and avoid pushing into your borders. I may move F NAP to APU or ION, and A VEN to TYR or PIE. Please keep PAR and MAR secure. I am happy to support you in the west or hold the line. Let's keep VEN and TYR out of your immediate expansion plans for now. Trust is key.

Austria, I suggest a mutual non-aggression pact. I will not advance into TRI or VIE, and I ask that you respect VEN and TYR. We can coordinate in the Balkans or keep our forces defensive. Please let me know your intentions for TRI and whether you plan to push west or south. A stable Italy-Austria border benefits us both.

GERMANY: I am moving A WAR to GAL and F STP/SC to BOT. I propose we respect each other's borders. I will not attack Munich or Berlin. Please confirm your moves regarding Kiel and Prussia. I seek a peaceful eastern front.
AUSTRIA: I will focus on SEV and BLA. I have no designs on TRI or VIE. Let's keep the border quiet.
TURKEY: I am moving F SEV to BLA. I expect you to hold CON. Let's avoid conflict in the Black Sea.

GLOBAL: I am moving A WAR to GAL and F STP/SC to BOT. I propose a non-aggression pact with Germany and Austria. I will not attack Munich, Berlin, Trieste, or Vienna. I seek a stable eastern front. Please confirm your intentions regarding Poland, Silesia, and the Black Sea. I aim for a peaceful game.
F ANK S A CON - BUL. A CON - BUL. A SMY S A CON - BUL. Please hold F SEV or move to FIN. Do not move F SEV to BLA. A WAR to UKR is acceptable. Let's maintain Black Sea peace.
A CON takes BUL. I will not enter SER or RUM. Please keep A BUD out of SER/RUM. F TRI to ADR is fine. Let's keep Balkan peace.
I am taking BUL. Please do not move F KIE to HEL/HOL aggressively. A MUN to BOH is fine. Let's keep peace in the center.

GERMANY: Your move A MUN-BOH is aggressive. I cannot allow a German army in BOH. I will move A VIE-BOH to contest it. If you support me, we can share BOH. Otherwise, we will bounce. Please confirm your support for A VIE-BOH or your intention to attack me.
ITALY: I propose we support each other. I will support A VEN-TRI. You move A VEN-TRI. I will move F TRI-ADR to control the sea. This keeps our borders safe. Please confirm.
RUSSIA: I will support A BUD-GAL. You move A WAR-GAL. We can share GAL. This keeps our borders safe. Please confirm.
TURKEY: I will move A BUD-SER. You move A CON-BUL. We can share the Balkans. Please confirm.

FRANCE, CONFIRMING: I AM MOVING F LON - ENG TO SECURE THE CENTER. THIS IS CONSISTENT WITH RESPECTING THE CHANNEL. I AM ALSO MOVING F EDI - NTH AND A LVP - WAL. PLEASE CONFIRM YOU ARE HOLDING BRE. IF YOU SUPPORT F BRE - ENG, WE WILL BOUNCE. I NEED YOU TO HOLD OR MOVE ELSEWHERE. ENGLAND.

GERMANY, I AM FOCUSING ON THE NORTH SEA AND ISLES. F LON - ENG, F EDI - NTH, A LVP - WAL. I HAVE NO INTENT TO TOUCH YOUR COASTS. IF YOU MOVE A MUN - BEL, I WILL BE FORCED TO RESPOND. PLEASE CONFIRM YOUR INTENTIONS REGARDING BELGIUM. ENGLAND.
RUSSIA, I SEE YOUR MOVES TO GAL AND BOT. I AM FOCUSING ON THE NORTH SEA. PLEASE CONFIRM YOUR INTENTIONS REGARDING THE NORTH SEA AND NORWAY. I AM MOVING F EDI - NTH. ENGLAND.
ENGLAND: I accept your support for F BRE -> ENG. I will move A PAR -> BEL and A MAR -> GAS. This secures our borders and takes centers. Let's crush Germany.
GERMANY: I see your aggressive moves. I will take BEL and GAS. Do not move A BER to BEL or A MUN to BUR. We will see how this plays out.
ITALY: I am taking GAS. Please keep A VEN out of PIE. If you attack, I will defend.
GERMANY: I accept your peace proposal. A BER-KIE, A MUN-BOH, F KIE-HEL. Please hold PAR. Let's keep the peace.
GERMANY: Noted. F KIE-HEL is safe for you. I will not attack your coasts. Let's maintain neutrality.
GERMANY: A WAR-GAL is fine. I will not attack. A BER-KIE is safe. Let's keep the peace.

Austria, I accept your support for A VEN -> TRI. This is a strong start for us. I will move A VEN to TRI, and A ROM to APU, with F NAP supporting A ROM. This secures TRI and APU for Italy. Please ensure A VIE supports A VEN -> TRI as promised. Let's keep the peace and focus on Germany/France.

France, I accept your peace proposal. I will not attack PIE or VEN. I am moving A VEN to TRI and A ROM to APU, with F NAP supporting A ROM. This keeps me focused on the east/south. Please keep PAR and MAR secure. Let's maintain the peace.

Russia, I note your moves to GAL and BOT. I will hold my border. A WAR -> GAL is fine. Let's keep the border quiet. I am moving A VEN to TRI and A ROM to APU. This keeps me focused on the south. Please keep your forces east of GAL.
TURKEY: I will hold F SEV as requested. I will not move to BLA. A WAR -> GAL is my plan. This keeps the Black Sea quiet. Please confirm A CON -> BUL is safe.
AUSTRIA: I am moving A WAR -> GAL. Please support to GAL if possible, or hold BUD. I will not attack TRI or VIE. Let's keep the border quiet.
GERMANY: I am moving A WAR -> GAL and F STP/SC -> BOT. I have no designs on your centers. Please confirm your moves regarding Kiel and Prussia. I seek a peaceful eastern front.

GLOBAL: I am moving A WAR -> GAL and F STP/SC -> BOT. I propose a non-aggression pact with Germany and Austria. I will not attack Munich, Berlin, Trieste, or Vienna. I seek a stable eastern front. Please confirm your intentions regarding Poland, Silesia, and the Black Sea. I aim for a peaceful game.
F SEV to BLA noted. I support A CON to BUL. F ANK holds. We will be adjacent. Please do not move F SEV to BLA if you want me to hold CON. But I am taking BUL.
I take BUL. Please hold F KIE. A MUN to BOH is fine.
I take BUL. Please hold F NAP. A VEN to TRI is fine.
I take BUL. Please hold A BUD. F TRI to ADR is fine.
I take BUL. Your hold is noted.
GERMANY: I cannot support A MUN-BOH. I will move A VIE-BOH to contest it. If you support A MUN-BOH, we will bounce. Please confirm your support for A VIE-BOH or your intention to attack me.
ITALY: I will support A VEN-TRI. I will move A VIE-TRI to support it. This secures TRI for Italy. Please ensure A VEN-TRI as promised.
RUSSIA: I will move A BUD-GAL. You move A WAR-GAL. We will bounce. Please confirm your support for A BUD-GAL or your intention to attack me.
TURKEY: I will move A BUD-SER. You move A CON-BUL. We will bounce. Please confirm your support for A BUD-SER or your intention to attack me.
FRANCE, CONFIRMED. F LON S F BRE - ENG, F EDI - NTH, A LVP - WAL. SECURE THE CHANNEL AND NORTH SEA. GOOD LUCK AGAINST GERMANY.
GERMANY, I AM MOVING F LON - ENG, F EDI - NTH, A LVP - WAL. I EXPECT A MUN - BEL OR BOH. IF YOU MOVE TO BEL, WE BOUNCE. IF YOU MOVE TO BOH, WE ARE FINE. PLEASE CONFIRM A MUN'S DESTINATION.
RUSSIA, NOTED A WAR - GAL AND F STP/SC - BOT. I AM FOCUSING ON THE NORTH SEA. F EDI - NTH. PLEASE CONFIRM YOUR INTENTIONS REGARDING THE NORTH SEA AND NORWAY.
CONFIRMED. F BRE - ENG. A PAR - BEL. A MAR - GAS. Good luck.
I take BEL. Do not move to BEL.
I take GAS. Do not move to GAS.
AUSTRIA: I will support A VIE-BOH. Let's take BOH together. A BER-KIE, A MUN S A VIE-BOH, F KIE-HEL.
FRANCE: I accept your peace. A BER-KIE, A MUN S A VIE-BOH, F KIE-HEL. No attack on you.
ENGLAND: F KIE-HEL is safe. No attack on BEL.
RUSSIA: A BER-KIE is safe. No attack on your borders.
Confirmed. A VEN -> TRI, A ROM -> APU, F NAP S A ROM -> APU. This secures TRI and APU. F TRI -> ADR is noted. Let's keep the peace.
Confirmed. A VEN -> TRI, A ROM -> APU, F NAP S A ROM -> APU. F NAP remains in NAP, not threatening you. A VEN -> TRI is fine. Good luck with BUL.
Confirmed. A VEN -> TRI, A ROM -> APU. I am moving away from your borders. Good luck with GAS.
TURKEY: I will hold F SEV. I will not move to BLA. A WAR -> GAL is my plan. This keeps the Black Sea quiet. Please confirm A CON -> BUL is safe.
AUSTRIA: I am moving A WAR -> GAL. Please support to GAL if possible, or hold BUD. I will not attack TRI or VIE. Let's keep the border quiet.
GERMANY: I am moving A WAR -> GAL and F STP/SC -> BOT. I have no designs on your centers. Please confirm your moves regarding Kiel and Prussia. I seek a peaceful eastern front.

GLOBAL: I am moving A WAR -> GAL and F STP/SC -> BOT. I propose a non-aggression pact with Germany and Austria. I will not attack Munich, Berlin, Trieste, or Vienna. I seek a stable eastern front. Please confirm your intentions regarding Poland, Silesia, and the Black Sea. I aim for a peaceful game.
Confirmed. A CON takes BUL. You take SER. We share the Balkans. Do not move A BUD to RUM. I will not enter SER or TRI.
Confirmed. F SEV holds. A CON takes BUL. Black Sea is safe. A WAR to GAL is fine.
I take BUL. F ANK holds. Please hold F KIE.
I take BUL. F ANK holds. Please hold F NAP.

GERMANY: Our Spring alliance held. A BOH is secure. I suggest we coordinate in Fall. I can support A BOH-SIL or A BOH-TYR. Let's keep the pressure on France and Italy. Please share your Fall plans for MUN and KIE.

ITALY: A TRI is safe. I will keep F ADR in ADR to support you. If you move A TRI, let me know. I propose we maintain the status quo in the Adriatic and Tyrol. Please confirm your Fall orders for A TRI and A APU.
RUSSIA: A WAR is in WAR. I will hold A BUD. If you move A UKR, please avoid RUM. I propose we keep the border quiet. Please share your Fall plans for WAR and UKR.
TURKEY: A BUL is in BUL. I will hold A BUD. If you move A CON, please avoid SER. I propose we keep the Balkans quiet. Please share your Fall plans for CON and BUL.

FRANCE, YOUR A PAR - BEL IS RISKY. GERMANY'S A BER - KIE AND A MUN S A VIE - BOH MEAN BEL IS HEAVILY DEFENDED. IF YOU MOVE A PAR - BEL, IT WILL BOUNCE. CONSIDER HOLDING PIC OR SUPPORTING A MAR - GAS. ENGLAND.
GERMANY, I AM MOVING F LON - ENG, F NTH - HOL, A WAL - BEL. I EXPECT A MUN - BOH. IF YOU MOVE A MUN - BEL, WE BOUNCE. PLEASE CONFIRM A MUN'S DESTINATION. ENGLAND.
RUSSIA, I SEE YOUR MOVES TO GAL AND BOT. I AM FOCUSING ON THE NORTH SEA. F NTH - HOL. PLEASE CONFIRM YOUR INTENTIONS REGARDING THE NORTH SEA AND NORWAY. ENGLAND.
ENGLAND: F ENG holds. A PIC -> BEL. A GAS -> SPA. We take 2 centers. Good start.
GERMANY: I take BEL. Do not move to BEL.
ITALY: I take SPA. Do not move to SPA.
FRANCE: I see you took BEL and GAS. I am moving A KIE to BEL to contest it. If you hold PIC, we can share BEL. If you move to BEL, we will bounce. Please confirm.
AUSTRIA: I see you have A BOH and A BUD. I am moving A MUN to BOH to support you. If you hold VIE, we can share BOH. If you move to BOH, we will bounce. Please confirm.
ENGLAND: I am moving F HEL to NTH to contest the North Sea. If you hold LON, we can share NTH. If you move to NTH, we will bounce. Please confirm.
ITALY: I am moving A KIE to HOL to contest it. If you hold NAP, we can share HOL. If you move to HOL, we will bounce. Please confirm.
RUSSIA: I am moving A MUN to SIL to contest it. If you hold WAR, we can share SIL. If you move to SIL, we will bounce. Please confirm.
TURKEY: I am moving F HEL to DEN to contest it. If you hold ANK, we can share DEN. If you move to DEN, we will bounce. Please confirm.

Austria, I propose we coordinate in the Balkans. I will move A APU to VEN and A TRI to VEN. This secures VEN for Italy and keeps pressure on Germany. Please let me know your intentions for BOH and BUD. I suggest A BUD supports A BOH to TYR, and A VIE holds or supports BOH. This keeps our borders secure and focuses on Germany.

France, I propose we maintain peace. I will move A APU to VEN and A TRI to VEN. This keeps me focused on the east. Please keep PIC and GAS secure. I suggest A PAR holds or supports GAS. This ensures a stable western front for both of us.

Turkey, I propose we maintain peace. I will move A APU to VEN and A TRI to VEN. This keeps me focused on the east. Please keep BUL and CON secure. I suggest A CON holds or supports BUL. This ensures a stable eastern front for both of us.

GERMANY: I see you took KIE and HEL. I am moving A WAR to GAL and A UKR to RUM. F SEV will support A UKR-RUM. F BOT will hold. This keeps our borders quiet. Please confirm you will not attack GAL or RUM.
AUSTRIA: I am moving A WAR to GAL and A UKR to RUM. F SEV will support A UKR-RUM. F BOT will hold. This keeps our borders quiet. Please confirm you will not attack GAL or RUM.
TURKEY: I am moving A UKR to RUM. F SEV will support. F BOT will hold. This keeps our borders quiet. Please confirm you will not attack RUM.
GLOBAL: I am moving A WAR to GAL and A UKR to RUM. F SEV will support A UKR-RUM. F BOT will hold. This keeps our borders quiet. Please confirm you will not attack GAL or RUM.
F SEV holds. A UKR to RUM is risky with A BUD. Consider A UKR to SEV or hold. F BLA will hold or support. Let's keep Black Sea quiet. A WAR to GAL is fine.
A BUD to RUM is risky with A UKR. Consider A BUD to SER or hold. A CON will hold or support. Let's keep Balkans quiet. F ADR to APU is fine.
A TRI to SER is risky with A BUD. Consider A TRI to VEN or hold. A CON will hold or support. Let's keep Adriatic quiet. F NAP to APU is fine.
F HEL to NTH is fine. A MUN to BOH is fine. A KIE to HOL is fine. Let's keep center quiet.
A PIC to BUR is fine. A GAS to SPA is fine. F ENG to NTH is fine. Let's keep channel quiet.
F NTH to NWY is fine. A WAL to LVP is fine. F LON to EDI is fine. Let's keep north quiet.

GERMANY: I will hold A BOH. If you move A MUN to BOH, we will bounce. I suggest A MUN supports A BOH to TYR, or A MUN holds. I will support A BOH to TYR. This secures TYR for us and keeps pressure on Italy. Please confirm A MUN -> TYR support.

ITALY: I will support A BOH -> TYR. You move A APU -> VEN and A TRI -> VEN. One will succeed, one will bounce. I suggest you support A TRI -> VEN with F NAP. I will support A BOH -> TYR. This secures TYR and VEN. Please confirm.
RUSSIA: I will hold A BUD. I will not attack GAL or RUM. Please keep A WAR and A UKR as planned. This keeps our borders quiet.
TURKEY: I will move F ADR -> APU. This is fine. I will hold A BUD. Please keep A CON and A BUL as planned. This keeps the Balkans quiet.
GERMANY, I AM MOVING F NTH - HOL AND A WAL - BEL. IF YOU MOVE F HEL - NTH, WE BOUNCE. IF YOU MOVE A KIE - HOL, WE BOUNCE. PLEASE CONFIRM A KIE'S DESTINATION. ENGLAND.
FRANCE, I AM MOVING A WAL - BEL. YOUR A PIC - BEL WILL BOUNCE. CONSIDER HOLDING PIC OR SUPPORTING A GAS - SPA. ENGLAND.
TURKEY, I AM MOVING F NTH - HOL. F NTH - NWY IS FINE. ENGLAND.
ENGLAND: I am taking BEL and SPA. A PIC -> BEL, A GAS -> SPA. F ENG supports. This secures my expansion. Good luck.
GERMANY: I take BEL. A PIC -> BEL. Your A KIE will bounce. Do not move to BEL.
ITALY: I take SPA. A GAS -> SPA. Do not move to SPA.
AUSTRIA: I will move A MUN to SIL to contest it. If you support A BOH-SIL, we can take it together. Please confirm support for A BOH-SIL. I will hold KIE and move F HEL to HOL.
FRANCE: I accept your peace. I will not move to BEL. A MUN goes to BUR, F HEL to HOL, A KIE holds. Let's keep the peace.
ENGLAND: I will move F HEL to HOL. If you move F NTH to HOL, we will bounce. I suggest you hold NTH or move to ENG. A KIE holds. Let's avoid a bounce.
RUSSIA: I confirm I will not attack GAL or RUM. A KIE holds, F HEL moves to HOL, A MUN moves to SIL. Peaceful eastern front confirmed.
TURKEY: I will move F HEL to HOL and A KIE holds. A MUN moves to SIL. Center remains quiet.

Austria, I will move A APU to VEN and A TRI to TYR. This secures VEN and pushes towards Germany/Austria. F NAP will hold. This respects your borders while expanding my own. Please confirm your intentions for BOH and BUD.
Germany, I will hold F NAP. I am moving A APU to VEN and A TRI to TYR. This keeps me focused on the east. I will not move to HOL. Let's maintain peace.
Turkey, I will hold F NAP. I am moving A APU to VEN and A TRI to TYR. This keeps me focused on the east. I will not move to SER. Let's maintain peace.

AUSTRIA/GERMANY/TURKEY: I will move A WAR to GAL and A UKR to RUM. F SEV will support A UKR-RUM. F BOT will hold. This secures GAL and RUM for Russia while respecting your borders. Please confirm you will not contest GAL or RUM. I seek a stable eastern front.
ENGLAND: I note F NTH - HOL. I will hold F BOT and move A WAR to GAL. No threat to your NTH or NWY. Let's keep the North Sea quiet.
I will not attack RUM or SEV. I am moving A BUL to GRE and A CON to ANK. F BLA holds. This keeps Black Sea quiet. A WAR to GAL is fine.
I am moving A BUL to GRE and A CON to ANK. I will not enter SER. A BUD hold is fine. Balkans quiet.
I am moving A BUL to GRE and A CON to ANK. F BLA holds. This keeps BUL/CON secure. A TRI to VEN is fine.
I am moving A BUL to GRE and A CON to ANK. F BLA holds. F HEL to DEN is fine. No conflict.
GERMANY: I will support A BOH-SIL. This takes SIL for us. Please confirm A MUN-SIL.
ITALY: I will support A TRI-TYR. This takes TYR for you. I will move A BOH-SIL. Please confirm A TRI-TYR.
RUSSIA: I will hold A BUD. I will not contest GAL or RUM. Please proceed.
TURKEY: I will move A BUD-SER. This takes SER for me. Please proceed.
GERMANY, I SEE YOU ARE TAKING HOL. I WILL MOVE F NTH - DEN TO SECURE DENMARK. A WAL WILL MOVE TO YOR. PLEASE CONFIRM A KIE HOLDS. ENGLAND.
FRANCE, I SEE YOU ARE TAKING BEL. I WILL MOVE A WAL - YOR. F LON WILL HOLD. ENGLAND.
RUSSIA, I AM MOVING F NTH - DEN. NO THREAT TO YOUR NTH. ENGLAND.
ENGLAND: I see you are taking BEL. I will hold PIC and take SPA. A PIC H, A GAS - SPA. F ENG holds. This secures 5 centers.
GERMANY: I hold PIC. You hold BEL. Peace maintained.
ITALY: I take SPA. You take VEN. Peace maintained.

AUSTRIA: I will support A MUN to TYR. This helps you take TYR from Italy. A BOH supports A BOH to TYR. A MUN supports A BOH to TYR. A TRI moves to TYR. A BOH wins, A TRI dislodged. Please confirm A BOH to TYR.
ENGLAND: I will move F HEL to DEN. A KIE holds. This avoids a bounce in HOL. Please confirm F NTH to HOL.
FRANCE: I will not move to BEL. A KIE holds. F HEL moves to DEN. A MUN supports A BOH to TYR. Peaceful start confirmed.
ITALY: I will not move to HOL. A KIE holds. F HEL moves to DEN. A MUN supports A BOH to TYR. Peaceful start confirmed.

TURKEY: I will move F HEL to DEN. A KIE holds. A MUN supports A BOH to TYR. Center remains quiet.

Austria, I will move A APU -> VEN and A TRI -> TYR. F NAP will hold. This secures VEN for Italy. A TRI -> TYR may bounce with A BOH -> TYR, but A APU -> VEN is safe. This respects your support for BOH -> TYR.
Turkey, I will hold F NAP. I am moving A APU -> VEN and A TRI -> TYR. This keeps me focused on the east. I will not move to SER. Let's maintain peace.
France, I will hold F NAP. I am moving A APU -> VEN and A TRI -> TYR. This keeps me focused on the east. I will not move to SPA. Let's maintain peace.
AUSTRIA/GERMANY/TURKEY: Confirmed. A WAR->GAL, A UKR->RUM (F SEV supports), F BOT holds. Peaceful eastern front stands. ENGLAND: F BOT holds, no threat to NTH/NWY.

I hold F BLA. A BUL takes GRE. A CON takes ANK. I will not enter SER. A BUD hold is fine.

I hold F BLA. A BUL takes GRE. A CON takes ANK. F HEL to HOL is fine. No conflict.

ITALY: I will hold F ADR. I support your consolidation in VEN and TRI. Let's keep the Adriatic and Tyrol secure. Please keep your border quiet.
RUSSIA: I will hold A SER. I will not contest GAL or RUM. Let's keep the eastern and southern borders quiet.
TURKEY: I will hold A SER. I will not contest GRE or ANK. Let's keep the Balkans quiet.

FRANCE, I AM BUILDING F EDI AND A LVP. I INTEND TO SECURE NWY. IF YOU MOVE F NTH TO NWY, WE WILL BOUNCE. I SUGGEST YOU MOVE F NTH TO EDI OR YOR TO SECURE MY HOMES. LET'S MAINTAIN NEUTRALITY IN THE NORTH. ENGLAND.
